lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance spots posterior to the gill region. Primary nodes are organized into vertical columns of 3 to 4 distinct circular clusters with uniform spacing of approximately 50-80 pixel units between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular blobs, forming a matrix where the blobs serve as high-intensity anchor points at the center of each vertical stripe segment.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible. The primary lateral ridge displays a sharp luminance contrast with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal-facing edge and a significant shadow-based gradient on the ventral-facing edge, running parallel to the body axis.
